fields.name: Nolan La
fields.title: Business Fellow | Strategy & M&A | Baylor University
fields.bio: Strategy professional with a passion for solving complex business problems through technology and data-driven insights. I'm currently working with Baylor Angel Network in early-stage venture analysis and will be joining KPMG's Strategy & M&A team in 2026. My background spans finance, strategic planning, and technology implementation across leading organizations including Dell, Southwest Solutions, and Stella Mattina.

fields.title: Learning Log
fields.summary: A Django web application for tracking learning progress and notes
fields.business_problem: Need a simple way to document and organize learning materials across multiple topics
fields.description: A full-stack Django application that allows users to create topics and log entries. Features include user authentication, entry editing/deletion, and topic organization. Built with Django ORM, Bootstrap, and SQLite.
fields.key_features: User authentication, Topic management, Entry logging and editing, Responsive design
fields.your_role: Full-stack developer - designed database schema, implemented all views and templates
fields.biggest_challenge: Implementing efficient database queries for large entry collections while maintaining performance
fields.lessons_learned: Importance of database indexing, user experience design, and clean code organization

fields.title: Campus SkillSwap
fields.summary: A peer-to-peer skill sharing platform for college students
fields.business_problem: College students want to learn new skills from peers but lack a centralized platform to connect and coordinate
fields.description: A Django web application connecting students who want to teach and learn skills from each other. Features include skill profiles, matching algorithms, scheduling, and reviews. Designed to build community while facilitating knowledge transfer.
fields.tools_used: Django, Python, PostgreSQL, Bootstrap, JavaScript, Django REST Framework
fields.key_features: Skill profiles and matching, User authentication, Scheduling system, Review and ratings, Notification system
fields.your_role: Led project architecture and backend development, implemented matching algorithm
fields.biggest_challenge: Building an intelligent matching algorithm that considers user preferences and availability
fields.lessons_learned: Importance of MVP approach, user testing, and scalable architecture design

fields.title: n8n Automation Workflow
fields.summary: Automated business process workflows using n8n no-code platform
fields.business_problem: Manual data entry and repetitive business processes were consuming significant time and prone to errors
fields.description: Designed and implemented comprehensive automation workflows using n8n connecting multiple APIs and services. Workflows handle data extraction, transformation, and integration across platforms including Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, and custom databases.
fields.tools_used: n8n, APIs, Webhooks, Google Workspace, Slack, MongoDB
fields.key_features: Data extraction and transformation, Multi-platform integration, Error handling and logging, Scheduled execution
fields.your_role: Workflow architect and implementer - designed entire workflow logic and API integrations
fields.biggest_challenge: Handling complex error scenarios and ensuring reliability across multiple external services
fields.lessons_learned: Power of no-code platforms, importance of error handling, and API rate limit management

fields.title: Early-Stage Venture Analyst
fields.description:
Performing due diligence, building financial models, and conducting market research for early-stage companies, to assess investment potential for 140+ angel investors with over a $60m investment portfolio.
Evaluated capital structures including SAFE notes, equity, and convertible debt for startups across the MedTech, Consumer Packaged Goods, and AI SaaS sectors with $10m+ valuations seeking funding between $1m-$4m.

fields.title: Summer Financial Analyst
fields.description:
Analyzed 30+ server deals worth over $10m in revenue for Dells Infrastructure Solutions Pricing Group, pricing GPU and CPU SKUs and building a standardized storage pricing tool to improve deal profitability and margins.
Developed VBA macros to automate P&L statement generation and the standardization of financial reporting processes, cutting processing time by 2 hours per week and improving the consistency of deal analysis.

fields.title: IT Implementations Intern
fields.description:
Built out dynamic tables and graphs with SQL for a $1m paper scanning project by collaborating with IT professionals displaying day-to-day worker productivity, improving data management and project efficiency.
Traveled to 6 client sites to troubleshoot technical issues with storage systems, improving system efficiency and uptime, having installed and configured 10+ software solutions to enhance overall IT performance.

fields.title: Revenue Cycle Management Intern
fields.description:
Managed medical billing systems for a healthcare acquisition holding company, tracking insurance payments and revenue cycle pricing across 12 OB/GYN practices across the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex.
Assisted in the acquisition of an OB/GYN family office by digitizing 300+ patient files and conducting market research to adjust procedure pricing in line with regional benchmarks to improve firm financial performance.

fields.title: Co-Founder
fields.description:
Founded Baylors first coordinated move-out donation program, leading 23 volunteers to divert 50,000+ pounds of items (estimated $200k+) from landfills to 11 non-profit organizations, solving a major sustainability challenge.
Designed and implemented an operational framework across 16 residence halls, collaborating with campus sustainability departments to streamline collection, sorting, and transportation to maximize efficiency and scalability.

fields.title: Director of Recruitment
fields.description:
Recruited 39 new students by conducting targeted outreach, hosting two information sessions and three foundation series sessions to introduce new members to core consulting principles, frameworks, and career pathways.
Advised a cold plunge tub startup supplying NFL teams, on developing a recurring revenue model; created a subscription pricing strategy for tub and ice machine cleaners, projecting $75+ yearly revenue per customer.
